title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: This project provided lifesaving emergency assistance to the internally displaced people (IDPs) affected by a sandstorm at the Al-Anad IDP site in Tuban District, Lahj Governorate. The project reached 638 people (325 male and 313 female) with emergency shelter and WASH services. 127 shelters were constructed and because the sandstorm also impacted the emergency latrines, water tanks, and water collection points in the Al-Anad IDP site, Concern installed a water tank within the IDP site, and a pipeline was installed to connect the tank to an existing solar water system outside the site to provide undisrupted and safe access to water for the residents. 15 emergency latrines were also constructed for families without access to latrines, including one latrine designed, especially for a person with a disability in one family. Concern used the latrine design made of fiberglass structure to reduce the heat, and the structure was fixed on the pit to reduce the risk of damage from future storms. .
